Probe: upsertNodes with 200 nodes => 200 rows in ~9.4 ms; addEdges with 200 edges => 200 rows in ~8.9 ms, both in one transaction each; delta on the openReadOnly wrapper worked, saw a writer's committed insert, and both delta SELECTs run inside one read transaction (lib/db.js:524-566). openReadOnly supports a read-only server: reads/search/stats/delta work, writes and DDL fail. Residual performance/integrity notes: per-row prepare churn (medium M4R) and addEdge's INSERT OR IGNORE silently drops malformed/cross-scan edges (medium M8); no deletion tombstones (low L10).

medium.title: Bulk writers are one transaction each but still prepare per row
medium.evidence: upsertNodes maps upsertNode over the array; upsertNode prepares SELECT and INSERT/UPDATE on every call. addEdges loops addEdge, which prepares the INSERT on every edge. A 200-row batch is usable (~9 ms) but pays ~400 prepares for nodes and 200 for edges; the previous M4 request to cache prepared statements was not implemented.
medium.fix: Move prepare calls outside the loops or cache statements on the db wrapper; keep the single-transaction behavior.

medium.title: addEdge/addEdges silently ignore malformed or cross-scan edges
medium.evidence: addEdge uses INSERT OR IGNORE and validates only kind. Probe addEdge(scan, nodeId, null, 'link') returned false with no error. src/dst are not checked to belong to scanId, so an edge can link nodes from another scan (FK only checks node existence); INSERT OR IGNORE also hides NOT NULL violations.
medium.fix: Validate src/dst scan ownership before insert, use plain INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(scan_id,src,dst,kind) DO NOTHING, and throw on NOT NULL/FK violations instead of returning false silently.

low.title: bodies.text preview cap is applied in UTF-16 code units, not UTF-8 bytes
low.evidence: The FTS guard correctly uses Buffer.byteLength, but sourceText.slice(0, FTS_TEXT_CAP) caps characters. Probe with 1,100,000 Cyrillic chars (2,200,000 bytes) stored 2,200,000 bytes in bodies.text while still excluding it from FTS. Spec §5 does not require a byte cap on bodies.text, so this is a preview-size nuance, not an index leak.

low.title: Present-but-undefined fields are treated as explicit null
low.evidence: incoming is built with `field in node`; {label: undefined} therefore clears label instead of keeping it. Omitted fields behave correctly (M1 fixed); undefined-valued fields are an edge case not covered by tests.

low.title: input.truncated forces fts_truncated=1 even when the body is fully indexed
low.evidence: ftsTruncated starts as input.truncated ? 1 : 0; a small body passed with truncated:true is indexed in full but reported as fts_truncated=1. The spec flag is meant to say the body is absent from the index.

low.title: withTransaction RELEASE failure path can leave depth stale
low.evidence: The success-path RELEASE sp at line 93 is outside the try/catch; if RELEASE throws, writeDepth is not reset and the caller may see a still-open savepoint. Not reachable in normal operation.

low.title: No deletion tombstones in delta
low.evidence: delta selects rows with rev > cursor; edge DELETE does not bump edge rev and nodes/edges have no deleted flag. Degree triggers do surface endpoint changes, but a deleted edge itself is never delivered. Stage 1 does not delete edges during normal crawl; stage 3/7 should decide on tombstones.

low.title: search rule/snippet mapping is approximate
low.evidence: rule comes from MIN(findings.id) per node, not necessarily the matched finding; a title/url-only match returns snippet='' (probe confirmed). Spec §6 shows rule in hits, so this is a stage-4 mapping gap rather than a stage-1 functional failure.

low.title: isFtsSyntaxError accepts any errcode-1 message containing 'syntax' or 'malformed'
low.evidence: A hypothetical internal SQL syntax error or FTS index 'malformed' error with errcode 1 would be downgraded to no hits. Missing tables/columns were rethrown in probes; the broad match is a residual hardening gap.

low.title: Bulk atomicity and fts_docs UPDATE are exercised only by independent probes, not the committed suites
low.evidence: The suite asserts bulk counts and re-upsert results but not rollback on a mid-batch failure; putBody's fts_docs ON CONFLICT update path is not covered. Independent probes confirmed both work, but the guarantees are not regression-tested.

low.title: Broad error swallowing remains around PRAGMAs and the stats queue query
low.evidence: openDb swallows every PRAGMA failure (including foreign_keys=ON), and stats catches any queue query error and reports zeroes. Normal file DBs probe foreign_keys=1; this is a low-risk diagnostic gap.

notes: H1 and H2 are fixed and independently reproduced. `node lib/db.js --self-test` => 20 PASS, exit 0; forced failure => exit 1 with 19 fails. `npm test` => 21/21 pass, 0 skipped. Schema matches spec §5 with only the documented additive rev_seq table and nodes_ad trigger; deviations.md documents all five required deltas. No project source was modified, created, or deleted by this review; the hashes above are the state reviewed. Residual non-blocking issues are kept in medium/low: per-row prepared-statement churn (M4R), silent malformed/cross-scan edges (M8), multibyte preview cap nuance, undefined-field semantics, tombstones, and test-coverage gaps.
